title: The blanket
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies (the trilogy ran in print in three papers)
logline: Wednesday. A faded wool blanket. The strip finds it in the frame shop's old backroom — Gully has the key — where it's been under the cutting table since 2000. Wood takes it home. Sunday it will be in the strip's most-read panel.

panels.composition: The frame shop, closed three years, dark. GULLY with the key. WOOD in the backroom doorway. Dust.

image.prompt: quiet ink line with water bleeding over the edges, desaturated wet-on-wet in raw umber and Payne's gray and Prussian blue, a shuttered frame shop's dark backroom with a stocky man holding a key and a thin man in the doorway, dust in the light

panels.composition: Under the old cutting table: a folded wool blanket, faded, moth-edged. From the winter of 2000, when the backroom was where he hid.

image.prompt: quiet ink line with water bleeding over the edges, desaturated wet-on-wet in raw umber and Payne's gray and Prussian blue, close-up of a folded faded wool blanket under an old cutting table in dust
image.notes: The blanket of 'The Carry' (dw_2014-11-16). It was here in Oct 2000 (the racket weeks).

panels.composition: Wood picking it up. Shaking it. The dust in the light. Holding it a moment against his chest the way he'll hold something else on Sunday.

characters.pose: holding the blanket to his chest

image.prompt: quiet ink line with water bleeding over the edges, desaturated wet-on-wet in raw umber and Payne's gray and Prussian blue, a thin man holding a shaken-out wool blanket against his chest in a dusty room, no words

panels.composition: Gully locking the door behind them. Wood with the blanket under his arm. The shop's sign, dark: HECETA FRAME & MATTING, one letter gone.
